conviction_note: I found no unpriced company-level number. The print turns on Q3 current cloud backlog (CCB) growth against a bar of roughly 24.7-25% cc. Ahead of the release I found only small, mostly priced leans (cloud revenue tracking the upper half of the FY guide, and the CCB bar set at a deceleration that the Q2 organic rate does not yet show), offset by a stock up about 58% from its July low and sitting at the consensus target. So p_up is 52 on an abs_move of 7.5. That scale comes from the ADR options (about 6.5% event-implied on 2026-10-20) and from the last three CCB-driven reactions (Jan -11 to -17%, Apr about +4-6%, Jul +9.15%). The ranked impact_sum is +0.7 and the scaled number is +0.3. They agree in sign, and the gap between them is the run-up caveat applied to p_up.

FY cloud revenue: H1 +26% cc means H2 only needs ~19.6-23.3% cc. A comment toward the upper half, or a narrowing, is possible (mild up). OP guide is unlikely to move again. A 2027 commentary change is unknown.
unknown; the FY FCF guide is ~EUR 10bn and Q2 FCF was EUR 3.0bn (+27%)
Q3 margin: the hiring freeze vs Dremio/Prior Labs dilution. Roughly flat to slightly up y/y, inside the guide.

findings.finding: Cloud revenue is tracking the upper half of the FY guide. H1 cloud revenue grew +26% cc and Q2 +24% cc, against a FY guide of EUR 25.8-26.2bn cc (+23-25%). H2 therefore needs only ~19.6% (low end) to ~23.3% (high end) cc growth on H2-2025's ~EUR 10.9bn. That makes an 'upper half' steer or a narrowing at Q3 plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (guide confirmed, EPS beat): stock up ~4-6% (https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/sap-aktie-springt-nach-quartalszahlen-cloud-wachstum-treibt-kurs-fy26-guidance-setzt-massstab). Jan 2026 FY26 guide with CCB deceleration: -11% to -17% (https://ig.com/uk/news-and-trade-ideas/sap-shares-plunge-up-to-17--as-cloud-backlog-growth-disappoints--260129).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Sixteen-plus analysts can do this arithmetic, and the stock's 58% recovery reflects confidence in the cloud guide. What is not priced is whether management formally moves the range, since SAP has never shifted it intra-year in 2026. If it were priced, the consensus target (EUR 210, https://admiralmarkets.com/de/wissen/articles/shares/sap-aktie-q3-2026-zahlen-vorschau) would already be set on top-of-range numbers.
findings.independence: Q2 call: management 'remains confident in its full-year cloud outlook' and the pipeline after Sapphire was better than expected (search summary of https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sap-q2-earnings-call-highlights-010533873.html). Same company, different document.

findings.finding: The CCB bar sits at a deceleration (BofA 24.7% cc, UBS 'spürbare Verlangsamung', meaning a noticeable slowdown) that the reported run-rate has not yet shown. CCB cc grew 25% in Q1 and 26% in Q2, and Reltio, first included in Q2 at <1pp, keeps adding inorganically to the y/y rate in Q3. So an in-line-to-slightly-above CCB print is a little more likely than a miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: CCB is the line that moves this stock. Q4 2025 CCB +25% cc vs ~26% expected: -11% to -17% on 2026-01-29 (https://ig.com/uk/news-and-trade-ideas/sap-shares-plunge-up-to-17--as-cloud-backlog-growth-disappoints--260129). Q2 2026 CCB +26% cc, ahead: +9.15% to EUR 140.80 (https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/sap-aktie-915-prozent-sprung-auf-14080-euro-932365).
findings.original_quote: UBS (Briest): 'eine spürbare Verlangsamung des CCB-Wachstums' (a noticeable slowdown in CCB growth), quoted at https://admiralmarkets.com/de/wissen/articles/shares/sap-aktie-q3-2026-zahlen-vorschau (2026-10-12)
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference about the sign of a number nobody outside SAP has seen, against a bar that is disputed (24-25%). It is not an unpriced fact. If the market expected a beat, I would expect sell-side bars at 25.5-26% rather than published deceleration calls, and I would expect bulls such as Jefferies to say more than 'slightly ahead'.
findings.independence: Company guide 'slightly decelerate' from 25% for the FY (6-K, 2026-07-23). Q1 25% and Q2 26% cc leave room under that guide for a Q3 around 24-25%. That cuts the other way and is why this finding is small.

findings.finding: Cost measures in force since early July 2026: a hiring freeze outside AI core areas and travel-budget cuts. These support Q3 operating margin against the Dremio/Prior Labs dilution of >EUR 100m that the OP guide was already cut for. Jefferies expects a return to margin growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 margin fell 0.7pp and the OP guide was cut, yet the stock rose 9.15% because CCB dominated. The margin line has been secondary on recent prints.
findings.original_quote: 'Er trifft vor allem Stellen ohne direkten Bezug zu KI-Kernbereichen. Zusätzlich kürzt der Konzern Budgets für nicht-essentielle Geschäftsreisen deutlich.' (It mainly hits roles without a direct link to core AI areas. The group is also cutting budgets for non-essential business travel substantially.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The measures were public in July and the OP guide (EUR 11.8-12.2bn) already embeds them, so this lands inside guidance and is sized near 0.
findings.independence: https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/sap-aktie-ueberkauft-nach-kraftakt-936933 ('SAP bestätigt Cloud-Ziele für 2026 und kündigt Sparmaßnahmen an.', i.e. SAP confirms 2026 cloud targets and announces savings measures)

findings.finding: Q3 FX is a reported-growth tailwind. SAP's own table puts it at +1.5pp on cloud revenue growth at the June-30 rate of 1.14 USD/EUR. Q3-2026 EUR/USD averaged ~1.151 (Banque de France monthly averages 1.1417 / 1.1593 / 1.1513), slightly less favourable than that assumption, so nominal growth prints ~1-1.5pp above cc.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The market reads cc CCB, not nominal. Q4 2025's nominal +16% vs cc +25% headline confusion did not decide that reaction; the cc miss did.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The company disclosed the table and consensus is built on it. I filed it so that a nominal 'beat' is not mistaken for news.

findings.finding: Counterparties that reported after SAP's Q2 show firm enterprise-transformation demand. Accenture (SAP's largest SI partner) posted record managed-services bookings of $12.8bn in the quarter to 2026-08-31 and a FY27 outlook above the Street. TCS booked $9.6bn TCV in the September quarter. SAP partner q.beyond's Q3 new orders of EUR 49.7m nearly matched its whole H1 (EUR 51.9m), helped by an S/4HANA healthcare subsidiary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history of SAP reacting to SI read-throughs. Its moves come from its own CCB.
findings.why_not_priced: These are proxies, and macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis. Accenture and TCS are widely read, and q.beyond is tiny and partly inorganic (GITG). Sized small, net of the fact that SI bookings lag or lead SAP CCB unpredictably.

findings.finding: The bar for the reaction is high. Since the 23 July low of EUR 127.52 the stock has climbed to EUR 202.35 (+58%), with run-up +11% over 20 days and +27% over 60. It is now at the consensus target of EUR 210.39 (28 analysts), was flagged RSI-overbought in August, and price-target trims (Evercore to EUR 160 on 10-08; Berenberg to EUR 205 in August) sit against TD Cowen's raise. A merely in-line CCB risks being sold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 was bought from a depressed base (+9.15% at -45% vs 52w high). This print is the first from a recovered base, with no comparable recent precedent.
findings.original_quote: Kursziel-Konsens '210,39 €' von 28 Analysten; Aktie 'rund 50 % in weniger als drei Monaten' gestiegen (consensus target EUR 210.39 from 28 analysts; the stock rose about 50% in under three months)
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself, and it agrees with the baseline lean (-0.55, all run-up), so per the lessons it is not an independent edge and is sized small. What would show it unpriced: none. The ADR options price a symmetric ~6.5% move with slight call premium, not a crowded long.

baseline_tension: Mostly agreeing. The findings lean slightly positive on the numbers (cloud guide upper half, CCB bar set at a deceleration), while the run-up (+11% 20d, +27% 60d, +58% off the July low) and the -0.55 lean cut against a positive reaction. I applied that tension once, to p_up (52), not to the findings.
language_note: German broker-preview copy (Admiral DE, Börse Express) carried UBS's qualitative 'spürbare Verlangsamung des CCB-Wachstums' (noticeable slowdown in CCB growth) call and the 28-analyst EUR 210.39 target. English sources carried the BofA 24.7% number.

German sources (trading-treff, Börse Express) carried the July hiring freeze and travel-cut detail ('Stellen ohne direkten Bezug zu KI-Kernbereichen', i.e. roles without a direct link to core AI areas) and the dated price path from the 127.52 low. English sources did not.
EQS-News (German issuer channel, English text) was what established that no ad-hoc or Prognoseanpassung was filed before the print.
On the decisive line (CCB vs bar) the German sources carried nothing the English ones did not.
lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move': abs_move_pct 7.0 -> 7.5, anchored on ~6.5% ADR-implied plus CCB-driven reactions of 9-17%; the reaction history moves p_up, not size
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not agree with': the run-up/positioning finding agrees with the -0.55 lean, so -0.8 -> -0.5
'Finding inside what the company already guided': the cost-measures margin finding +0.2 -> +0.1
'Proxy / inference' plus a disputed bar: the CCB-bar inference +0.4 -> +0.3
'The move is in the guide': kept the cloud-revenue guidance finding at +0.6 as the line most likely to carry news
